template.title: Music Bingo at Aura
template.shortDescription: Thursday Music Bingo in The Vista with Four Dogs Entertainment.
template.description: Meet your people in The Vista for a Thursday night of familiar songs and Music Bingo with Four Dogs Entertainment at Aura Kitchen & Bar. The four confirmed trial dates are October 22, October 29, November 5, and November 12.
template.instructions: Contact Aura for seating and participation details. Music Bingo runs from 7:30 to 9:30 PM.

changes.title: College Hits: Throughout the Years Music Bingo
changes.shortDescription: College Hits: Throughout the Years Music Bingo at Aura in The Vista.
changes.description: Remember the hits that defined your college years? Bring your friends to Aura Kitchen & Bar for College Hits: Throughout the Years Music Bingo. From campus throwbacks to songs that still fill the playlist, listen, mark your card, and see how many favorites you recognize.

changes.title: Spooky Vibes Music Bingo
changes.shortDescription: Halloween-season songs and familiar spooky favorites at Aura.
changes.description: The soundtrack to spooky season is taking over Aura Kitchen & Bar. Spooky Vibes Music Bingo mixes Halloween favorites, unforgettable movie moments, and songs you know by heart. Grab your friends, listen for your picks, and make a Thursday night of it in The Vista.
changes.instructions: Contact Aura for seating and participation details. Music Bingo starts at 7:00 PM Eastern.

changes.title: DJ Jimbo’s Master Class Music Bingo
changes.shortDescription: DJ Jimbo’s Master Class Music Bingo at Aura Kitchen & Bar.
changes.description: Think you know your music? Put your playlist knowledge to the test with DJ Jimbo’s Master Class Music Bingo at Aura Kitchen & Bar. Expect a lively mix of recognizable songs, unexpected connections, and plenty of chances to shout, sing along, and mark your card.
changes.instructions: Contact Aura for seating and participation details. Music Bingo starts at 7:00 PM Eastern.

changes.title: Screen Time Music Bingo
changes.shortDescription: Screen Time Music Bingo with movie and TV favorites at Aura.
changes.description: You know the scene. Now name the song. Screen Time Music Bingo brings movie soundtracks, TV favorites, and unforgettable on-screen music to Aura Kitchen & Bar. Bring your crew, listen closely, and see which screen moments you recognize first.
changes.instructions: Contact Aura for seating and participation details. Music Bingo starts at 7:00 PM Eastern.
